THU AUG 20 7:20 AM PT RUN.

GOOGLE ADS -- Live Chrome scrape, account 343-687-4835, date filter 'Yesterday' = Aug 19. Re-read returned exactly the same totals as the 4:10 AM run, so Aug 19 is settled: 228 impressions, 11 clicks, 4.82% CTR, $17.59 cost, $1.60 avg CPC, and the conversions tile has now resolved from 'calculating' to 0.00 (down 1.00 vs Aug 18). The per-campaign table confirms nothing has changed overnight: 'Local store visits and promotions-Performance Max-2' ($58.37/day) is still PAUSED and additionally flagged 'Limited by budget'; 'Oldest SB Brewery on Tap' and 'World Cup HQ 2026' also paused. Only 'BHC Coffee | Search | P1 Launch' ($15.00/day) is serving, and it accounts for 100% of the day's impressions, clicks and spend. That is now two consecutive days with restaurant-side paid traffic at zero. Zero ad disapprovals. Google is showing an 'Optimize your budgets' card claiming missed conversions from budget limits (+7.8%), plus the Aug 17 target-based bid strategy banner across all 4 campaigns. ACTION: Joal needs to confirm whether pausing the main Performance Max campaign was intentional.

TOAST -- The Wednesday Aug 19 GROUP (all-locations) email arrived 6:26 AM PT and has been parsed. Net $3,940.90, gross $4,192.50, 134 orders, 179 guests, avg sales/order $29.41, avg sales/guest $22.02. Labor 29.5% of net ($1,162.57 derived) -- a meaningful step back from Tuesday's 25.0%. Discounts $251.60 (6.0% of gross, derived as gross minus net), refunds $0, 9 void items, 106 card payments, 0 open orders, no auto-clockouts. Takeout 17 orders / $176.85; dine-in 4 / $26.50. Compared with the same day last week (Wed Aug 12, computed here from that day's group email: net $5,014.42 / 193 guests / 121 orders): net -21.4%, gross -19.7%, guests -7.3%, but orders +10.7% -- so more tickets at a much lower average check ($29.41 vs $41.44). The 229 W Montecito single-location Daily Performance Summary had NOT arrived as of 7:20 AM PT (usually ~7:40 AM), so dayparts, revenue centers, check counts and void dollars are missing this run and will backfill tomorrow. Tuesday Aug 18's full detail has been moved to toastPrevDay and is intact.

SLING -- Thursday Aug 20 daily report received 7:00 AM PT. 8 employees / 8 shifts / 35.75 scheduled hours / 0 uncovered / 0 overtime / 0 off. Kitchen covered by Rafael Patricio (Cook). Roster: Rafael Patricio (Cook), Sarah Palmer (Barista), Tony Rincon (Bartender), Christine Vargas (Server), Harmony Willson (Bartender), James Hernadez (Server), Bri Kelley (Server), Julianna Ornelas (Barback). Up from 7 staff / 33.25 hrs on Wednesday -- worth watching against Wednesday's 29.5% labor number.

REVIEWS -- Not re-scraped this run; the 4:10 AM run this same morning live-verified both Google Business Profiles. 3 unanswered reviews, all 5-star: sergio salazar and Betty Chambers on The Brewhouse (4.5 / 526), Geoff Lay on Brewhouse Coffee (5.0 / 5). Draft replies are written and still awaiting Joal's approval -- nothing has been posted.

Credentials were not entered, per standing policy. This is day 14 of the login wall and the 13th consecutive failed run. unanswered.text: great food staff was on point very friendly, I highly recommend it and definitely driving 3 hours to go back.
unanswered.draftReply: Sergio, a three-hour drive back is about the best compliment we get. Glad the crew was on point and the food delivered. We'll have a cold one waiting whenever you make that trip again -- thanks for the recommendation!

unanswered.text: We were looking for a dog friendly restaurant on our way home to san diego. The food was great and our dog loved what you had. The waitress was great.
unanswered.draftReply: Betty, so glad we were the right stop on your way down to San Diego -- and that your pup approved too. Our servers genuinely light up when the dogs come through. Water bowls are always ready if you're ever heading back up the coast.
